newsitem.title: FINLAND: POSTIPANKKI'S MB UNIT SETS FIM 600 MLN FUND.
newsitem.headline: POSTIPANKKI'S MB UNIT SETS FIM 600 MLN FUND.

text.p: Finnish state owned bank group Postipankki Oy's MB Yritysrahoitus Oy said on Thursday it had set up a 600 million markka mezzanine fund, MB Mezzanine Fund Ky.
"Postipankki has invested 594 million markka in the fund and MB Yritysrahoitus six million markka," MB Yritysrahoitus said in a statement.
"The fund now established is the largest fund specialising in mezzanine finance in the Nordic countries," it said. MB Yritysrahoitus will administer the fund.
It said mezzanine finance, a form of financing midway between conventional debt and equity, is typically used in growth companies, corporate acquisitions and management buy-outs.
The maximum funding of any single project would be 150 million markka, it said.

"MB Mezzanine Fund Ky has made its first 150 million markka investment in funding the acquisition of Metsa-Serla Chemicals' business operations, in which the majority investor is Industri Kapital," MB Yritysrahoitus said.
Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla said in November it would sell its chemicals operations for 1.05 billion markka to Swedish Industri Kapital.
"The new fund is of the so-called facility type meaning that it will raise funding only when investments meeting the criteria emerge," MB Yritysrahoitus said.
